**385-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) Title 3 REVENUE AND FINANCE is hereby amended by adding 3.05 SOLID WASTE ENTERPRISE FUND

Sponsors:

Stephen Winslow, Karen Colon Hayes, Carey McDonald and Ryan O'Malley

**388-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) Title 3 REVENUE AND FINANCE is hereby amended by adding 3.10 RESERVE AND STABILIZATION FUND FRAMEWORK

Sponsors:

Amanda Linehan, Ryan O'Malley and Stephen Winslow

headline: Ordinances to add a Solid Waste Enterprise Fund and a Reserve and Stabilization Fund Framework to the city's finance code.
summary: The committees will discuss two proposed ordinances. One would add a Solid Waste Enterprise Fund (3.05) and the other would add a Reserve and Stabilization Fund Framework (3.10) to Title 3 of the City of Malden Code.

388-26 Ordinance amending Title 3 Revenue and Finance to add 3.10 Reserve and Stabilization Fund Framework (Sponsors: Amanda Linehan, Ryan O'Malley and Stephen Winslow)
